inclusion_rule: Original X video post with reported views strictly greater than 10,000 at the recorded check time.
verification_scope: Official X oEmbed text and public video metadata were checked. View counts come from the linked public metadata snapshots; selected posts were also inspected in the signed-in X browser. Model use is creator-reported. Videos have not been independently reproduced or fully fact-checked.
media_policy: Original videos and thumbnails remain hosted by their creators/platform. No videos were downloaded or reuploaded.
tool_disclosure_scope: Tools and auxiliary models are taken from creator posts, source repositories or shared briefs. Their actual execution was not independently verified. Empty lists mean no specific additional tools or models were identified, not that none were used.
